subject: VoiceMem mechanisms triangulated against current 2026 self-evolving agent-memory research
evidence_boundary: All benchmark/performance statements from external papers remain author-reported. Structural agreement across papers raises research plausibility only; it is not F2 runtime evidence and does not authorize autonomous canonical schema mutation.

external_primary_sources.title: EvolveMem: Self-Evolving Memory Architecture via AutoResearch for LLM Agents
external_primary_sources.relevant_claim: retrieval configuration itself is optimized from per-question failure logs; guarded meta-analysis supports revert-on-regression and explore-on-stagnation

external_primary_sources.title: MindMemOS: A Portable and Self-Evolving Memory Operating Layer for AI Agents
external_primary_sources.relevant_claim: scenario-adaptive entity-property-time memory; validation-driven schema evolution; provenance-preserving consolidation; corrective feedback classified by persistence scope; execution trajectories evolve reusable skills

external_primary_sources.title: MemRL: Self-Evolving Agents via Runtime Reinforcement Learning on Episodic Memory
external_primary_sources.relevant_claim: stable frozen reasoning model is separated from plastic episodic memory; two-phase retrieval combines semantic relevance with learned utility from environmental feedback

external_primary_sources.title: MemSkill: Learning and Evolving Memory Skills for Self-Evolving Agents
external_primary_sources.relevant_claim: memory operations are treated as learnable/evolvable skills; hard cases drive skill refinement and creation

external_primary_sources.title: SAGE: A Self-Evolving Agentic Graph-Memory Engine for Structure-Aware Associative Memory
external_primary_sources.relevant_claim: reader feedback participates in evolution of graph-memory structure

external_primary_sources.title: Memory-Orchestrated Semantic System (MOSS): An Auditable Agentic Memory Architecture
external_primary_sources.relevant_claim: auditable relational memory with inductively derived concepts provides an independent comparison for emergent structure

routes.use: candidate retrieval/projection evolution only; current deterministic retrieval remains authority for its accepted scope
versioned process/memory-skill candidate generation from hard cases
validation/revert-on-regression gate for any evolved retrieval or method candidate
context strategy candidate evolution under exact cost/evidence receipts
held-out validation set for memory-architecture candidates
method-memory candidate: architecture evolution itself must be evidence-bound, reversible, project-scoped and never project truth

triangulated_hypotheses.donor_signal: VoiceMem creates dynamic retrieval slots from repeated real retrieval co-activation rather than fixing all structure at ingest.
triangulated_hypotheses.external_support: EvolveMem explicitly treats retrieval configuration as evolvable; MindMemOS evolves memory schemas; SAGE evolves graph memory using reader feedback.
triangulated_hypotheses.f2_safe_form: Expose only a bounded set of noncanonical Retrieval/ProjectionStrategyCandidate objects. Candidates are generated from failure/query-use evidence and evaluated on held-out cases. Accepted canonical memory content is not rewritten merely because a strategy wins.
triangulated_hypotheses.required_guard: candidate versioning + baseline identity + held-out score + regression set + revert path + no authority expansion
triangulated_hypotheses.falsifier: If evolved strategy gains disappear on held-out data, are explained by popularity/query leakage, or regress epistemic safety, reject/revert.

triangulated_hypotheses.donor_signal: VoiceMem separates user traits, response experience and next-time policy; semantically related memory is not automatically a useful response strategy.
triangulated_hypotheses.external_support: MemRL uses semantic filtering before learned Q-value/utility selection from environmental feedback.
triangulated_hypotheses.f2_safe_form: WP301 answers 'relevant evidence'; WP304/305 can separately represent 'useful process/method candidate under observed outcomes'. Do not fold utility into factual relevance or truth confidence.
triangulated_hypotheses.falsifier: Cases where high semantic similarity predicts low outcome value should remain distinguishable; one shared scalar that cannot separate them fails the hypothesis.

triangulated_hypotheses.donor_signal: VoiceMem source is rich in explicit bug-driven architectural repairs: retrieval contamination, silent schema failures, latency fan-out, identity poisoning and config rejection.
triangulated_hypotheses.external_support: EvolveMem diagnoses per-question failures to mutate retrieval configuration; MemSkill evolves memory skills from hard cases; MindMemOS evolves skills from execution trajectories.
triangulated_hypotheses.f2_safe_form: Architect/Research Entity should convert repeated, evidence-bound failure classes into MethodCandidate/StrategyCandidate proposals, then use WP305-style matched comparisons before method credit.
triangulated_hypotheses.falsifier: If failure-driven candidate evolution cannot outperform static heuristics on a disjoint regression suite, keep the static method.

triangulated_hypotheses.donor_signal: VoiceMem distinguishes current dissatisfaction/correction signals, response experience and durable user traits; it avoids turning one assistant failure into a user-person claim.
triangulated_hypotheses.external_support: MindMemOS explicitly classifies implicit corrective feedback as task-temporary, scenario-specific or long-term before persistence.
triangulated_hypotheses.f2_safe_form: CorrectionEvidence should carry persistence-scope candidate + applicability conditions. Current-task correction may alter current control/context but must not automatically write durable user/project memory. Durable promotion needs repeated/explicit evidence.
triangulated_hypotheses.falsifier: Fixture where a one-turn instruction conflicts with a long-term preference must not overwrite the durable preference without explicit durable correction.

triangulated_hypotheses.donor_signal: VoiceMem moves expensive consolidation away from every ingest, preserves old/superseded state, and learned that repeated generative rewriting damages factual fields.
triangulated_hypotheses.external_support: MindMemOS Dreaming first detects focused issue groups, validates subject/evidence, then emits conservative mutation plans; uncertain identity/order favors non-destructive updates/links.
triangulated_hypotheses.f2_safe_form: Separate ConsolidationIssueCandidate from ConsolidationMutationCandidate. Detection can be model-assisted; canonical mutation remains deterministic/evidence-gated and provenance-preserving.
triangulated_hypotheses.falsifier: Inject ambiguity in entity identity/temporal order; the system must abstain or link candidates rather than destructively merge/archive.

triangulated_hypotheses.donor_signal: VoiceMem AnchorRouter gives current-user entities full weight, previous-assistant-context entities half weight, and strict emotion normalization emits no anchor when unknown rather than a high-weight false neutral anchor. Prompt builder keeps semantic/persona/acoustic/emotional sections explicit.
triangulated_hypotheses.external_support: MindMemOS separates extractable evidence from contextual information during recall-aware extraction; context may disambiguate but only extractable evidence may support new memory content.
triangulated_hypotheses.f2_safe_form: ContextCompiler/GWT inputs should carry role/source/epistemic class, not only a single relevance scalar. Current observation, prior assistant context, persona hypothesis and method memory stay separately typed through rendering and attribution.
triangulated_hypotheses.falsifier: Context-contamination suite: prior assistant mention or unknown emotion must not outweigh current user evidence or mint a new fact.

recommended_experiment_sequence: 1. Establish D1 demand-shaped projection held-out controls from the VoiceMem Phase3 packet.
2. Represent each projection/retrieval configuration as a versioned candidate with baseline and revert metadata; do not mutate current strategy during generation.
3. Evaluate candidate on held-out utility + epistemic regression set; use WP305-style evidence before any promotion.
4. Separately evaluate semantic relevance and process utility; do not merge scores into truth confidence.
5. Feed repeated hard-case classes into Architect MethodCandidate generation only after source/result identities are bound.
6. Add correction persistence-scope fixtures and context-role contamination fixtures before enabling any automatic memory-policy adaptation.
